alia: Quick heads-up — rk3b-v2 (3B) int8 bringup shows NDCG@10 drop vs fp16 on the usual holdout. Rough: fp16 0.423 -> int8 0.414 overall, short queries (<=5 tokens) 0.392 -> 0.374. Anyone seen formatting sensitivity like this?
ben: Oof, ~-2.1 overall and ~-4.5 on short queries. Were the eval harness configs identical (tokenizer, seqlen, priming)?
eval-bot: Scheduled eval completed: /artifacts/1798880000/rk3b-v2-int8-eval.csv — metrics: ndcg10:0.414 mrr:0.312 (int8); ndcg10:0.423 mrr:0.319 (fp16).
carmen: Did we change the query surface? I noticed some priming changed from "Query: <q>" to inline prefix "Q:" in the preprocessing patch. That could truncate short queries differently.
david: Also check tokenizer settings — some runs were using legacy tokeniser flag (use_fast=False) during tokenization. Could change offsets for short queries.
ben: Can we reproduce with a controlled script? Run this:
```
python eval_rerank.py --model rk3b-v2 --quant int8 --holdout path/to/holdout.csv --query-template "Query: {q}" --tokenizer-opts "use_fast=True"
```
carmen: I'll run two smoke runs: original prefix vs stripped (no prefix). Also test HTML stripping (we have a bunch of doc snippets with tags).
alia: Good. Also check candidate ordering normalization — I saw a small shuffle introduced in preproc that might affect top1 for short queries.
david: Quick note: prefix caching on the serving runtime can change runtime KV states during live A/B, but eval harness is pure offline so shouldn't matter unless we cached contexts when generating candidates.
ben: Action items: 1) Carmen runs the two smoke evals and posts csvs 2) David verifies tokenizer flags and reproduces exact token counts for sample queries 3) Alia files a short regression ticket with attached diffs and worst-offending queries.
alia: Adding ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-9891 — attaching the eval csvs when Carmen posts.
carmen: Started run now. ETA ~12m. Will paste the top 10 worst queries when done. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
eval-bot: run started at 1798880006 for job id j-79321.
carmen: Finished. Top offender examples:
- "iOS update" -> int8 ranks doc B over A (expected A)
- "install" -> scores compressed by ~0.08
I'll upload csv to the ticket.
ben: Thanks — once we have those, let's also run a small ablation: quantize weights but keep embedding matrix fp16 (hybrid mode) and see lift.
alia: Good plan. Keep thread updated.
